meta.purpose: Master relationship file mapping notable unlocks, activities, drops, and echo content to Demonic Pacts League region requirements.
notes: This file is structured for planner/runtime use rather than display-only use.

Aggregate drop labels from league tables (for example 'All unique rewards' or 'Armadyl armour') do not always correspond to a single wiki page. For those entries, itemUrlSuffixes may be null and the source page is the canonical link target.
Most concrete wiki suffixes follow standard MediaWiki title normalization from the names shown in the cited league pages: spaces become underscores and special characters are URL-encoded.
Where the source material exposed a region summary but not every individual downstream page title, uncertain settlement/activity/shop URLs were intentionally omitted rather than guessed.

globalAvailabilityRules.description: Transportation methods such as charter ships, fairy rings, gnome gliders, balloons, customs officers and similar travel systems require the destination area to be unlocked.
Death's Office, the player-owned house, random events, Zanaris and the Abyss are universally accessible during the league.
When purchasing a player-owned house, it is placed in Aldarin; houses can only be moved to unlocked areas.
All Slayer Masters assign the same task pool, filtered by unlocked areas. Slayer Equipment shops in all regions also sell anti-dragon shields and elemental shields.
Items that normally drop as components that require multiple regions to assemble instead drop as finished items in the league.
All Soulreaper axe pieces can drop from every Desert Treasure II boss during the league.
Twisted bow, Scythe of Vitur, and Tumeken's shadow are available from Chambers of Xeric, Theatre of Blood, and Tombs of Amascut during the league.
Wilderness bosses do not require completion of the Wilderness Medium Diary during the league.
Zulrah has no damage cap or melee damage immunity during the league.
All League characters are Ironmen and cannot trade with other players or use the Grand Exchange.
Sailing is disabled in the Demonic Pacts League and cannot be used for inter-region travel.
Characters begin in a League-specific version of Yama's Lair before exiting into Varlamore; the lair also provides level-1 Agility access via stepping stones.
Baseline passive effects include 5x experience, with later relic tiers increasing the XP multiplier further.
Eligible item drops start at 2x as common, with later passive upgrades increasing league-wide drop boosts further.
Minigame points are boosted by 4x as part of the baseline passive effects.
Farming ticks occur every minute instead of every five minutes.
Run energy is never drained while running.
Clue scrolls drop as stackable scroll boxes and clue-step progress is saved between clues.

Most shop stock does not deplete in league worlds; Slayer Equipment shops sell anti-dragon and elemental shields, the Fortis General Store stocks box traps and bird snares, and the Sunset Coast charter shop stocks a hunter crossbow.
